statement: AMD has signed compute commitments totalling 8 gigawatts across Anthropic (2 GW) and OpenAI (6 GW), spreading frontier-lab accelerator demand beyond NVIDIA.
why: Gigawatt-scale commitments to a second merchant accelerator vendor are design wins that change how frontier-lab compute demand is split between suppliers.

impact.mechanism: Committed gigawatts at AMD lift total merchant-GPU demand while diverting a share of frontier-lab spend away from the incumbent supplier, diversifying counterparty risk across chip vendors.

evidence.excerpt: AMD has signed compute commitments totaling 8 gigawatts -- 2 gigawatts with Anthropic and 6 gigawatts with OpenAI -- distributing similar counterparty risk across chip suppliers.

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet; commitments stated in gigawatts with no dollar value or contract document read, so capped at medium.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> rising); sources: 247wallst.com, ir.amd.com
